units.source_text: 八月十五之夜，皓月当空，板屋多缝，处处透射进月光来。

en.t: On the night of the fifteenth day of the eighth month, the bright moon hung high in the sky, and moonlight streamed in everywhere through the many gaps in the plank-roofed house.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得这不曾见惯的住房的光景，反而富有奇趣。

en.t: Prince Genji found the unfamiliar sight of this dwelling unexpectedly full of charm.

units.source_text: 将近破晓之时，邻家的人都起身了。

en.t: As dawn drew near, the people in the neighboring houses all got up.

units.source_text: 只听见几个庸碌的男子在谈话，有一人说：

en.t: He could hear only a few ordinary men talking, and one of them said:
Business is not very good again this year.

units.source_text: 乡下市面也不成样，真有些担心。

en.t: The markets in the countryside are in poor shape too, and it really is rather worrying.
Hey, elder brother from the northern neighbor, listen to what I have to say!

units.source_text: 这班贫民为了衣食，天没亮就起来劳作，嘈杂之声就在耳旁，夕颜觉得很难为情。

en.t: These poor people rose before daybreak to work for their food and clothing, and with the noise right beside her ears, Yugao felt very embarrassed.

units.source_text: 如果她是一个爱体面的虚荣女子，住在这种地方真有陷入泥坑之感。

en.t: If she had been a vain woman who cared about appearances, living in such a place would truly have felt like sinking into a mire.

units.source_text: 然而这个人气度宽大，即使有痛苦之事、悲哀之事、旁人认为可耻之事，她也不十分介怀。

en.t: Yet she was broad-minded, and even things that were painful, sorrowful, or thought shameful by others did not trouble her very much.

units.source_text: 她的态度高超而天真，邻近地方极度嘈杂混乱，她听了也不很讨厌。

en.t: Her manner was noble and innocent, and even when the neighborhood was extremely noisy and chaotic, she did not find it especially hateful to hear.

units.source_text: 论理，与其羞愤嫌恶，面红耳赤，倒不如这态度可告无罪。

en.t: Reasonably speaking, this attitude was more blameless than growing red-faced with shame, anger, and disgust.

units.source_text: 那舂米的碓臼，砰砰之声比雷霆更响，地面为之震动，仿佛就在枕边。

en.t: The mortar and pestle pounding rice made a thudding sound louder than thunder, shaking the ground as if it were right beside the pillow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中想：“唉，真嘈杂！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought to himself, Ah, how noisy it is!

units.source_text: 但他不懂得这是什么声音，只觉得奇怪与不快。

en.t: But he did not understand what the sound was, and only felt it strange and unpleasant.
Besides this, there were many other disorderly noises.

units.source_text: 那捣衣的砧声，从各方面传来，忽重忽轻。

en.t: The sounds of mallets beating cloth came from every direction, now heavy and now light.

units.source_text: 其中夹着各处飞来的寒雁的叫声，哀愁之气，令人难堪。

en.t: Mixed among them were the cries of cold-weather geese flying in from all around, filling the air with a sorrow so deep it was hard to bear.
